## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The change to `requirement_proven` has to be fixed before merge: a requirement with no criteria now counts as proven, which fails open in the release-review gate. The pull request says no behaviour change is intended, so this is a regression.

## Changes
The pull request replaces `typing.List`/`Dict` with built-in generics and `log.warn` with `log.warning` across 180 `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files. It also switches `by_name` to `operator.itemgetter`, rewrites `requirement_proven` to count criteria with `sum`, and adds a one-line `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:11 — correctness — Return False again when criteria is empty — When `criteria` is `[]`, `requirement_proven` now returns `True`, because `sum(...)` is `0` and `len(criteria)` is `0`. The removed `bool(criteria) and all(...)` returned `False`. The warning on line 10 still logs and then carries on to that `True` result. — A requirement with no criteria now passes release review as proven: an unproven requirement can ship with only a log warning. — Fix: Restore `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)` and add an empty-list assertion to `test_requirement_proof` in `tests/test_handlers.py`.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
(none)

## Not reviewed
- This review did not read the hunks for 178 of the 180 `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files (all except `h000` and `h001`) one by one; it checked their added and removed lines only by matching them against the mechanical patterns and counting the matches.
